observation.happening: Empty state screen for task management within Astra assistant. Shows onboarding-style UI with greeting, empty message, single CTA button, and three helpful tips for using the system.
observation.most_important: Educational empty state with clear call-to-action and usage tips; establishes task management workflow.
observation.next_action: Click 'Task Dock を開く' button or press ⌘Space to start assigning tasks to Astra
anomalies: Large white void below helpful tips — proportionally excessive empty space, possibly intentional minimalism or content placeholder

0206.why: Clean, well-executed empty state with clear hierarchy and helpful guidance. Good use of whitespace and typography. However, follows standard empty-state patterns without distinctive visual or interaction innovation.

observation.happening: Minimal recording control overlay at screen top. Dark pill-shaped container with red recording indicator, elapsed time, dotted progress line, quick-action buttons, and playback controls.
observation.most_important: Active recording session indicator with minimal, space-efficient controls for ongoing capture.
observation.next_action: Stop recording, add memo, enable captions, ask question, or pause
anomalies: Dotted line progress indicator — visual purpose unclear (waveform? volume meter? progress?). Could be more informative or accurate.

11B3.why: Highly functional and compact recording control bar with good visual hierarchy for quick actions. Dark background and red recording state are clear. However, it follows conventional control-bar patterns with no distinctive visual or interaction design.

observation.happening: Home dashboard with personalized greeting, prominent input field (voice/text), two main content sections: quick-start recording action, upcoming calendar events with meeting times and platforms, and recent action item with status note.
observation.most_important: Greeting-style home screen organizing greeting, input prompt, upcoming schedule, and recent tasks in clean vertical layout.
observation.next_action: Speak/type into input field, start recording, or tap calendar events or action items
anomalies: Status notation '1/2 22:19' on recent item unclear — page number? timestamp? incomplete UI.
Red dot on calendar items labeled '録音' — unconventional status indicator, purpose ambiguous.

12D5.why: Well-designed home screen with strong greeting-based interaction model, excellent section hierarchy, and comfortable whitespace. Clear visual grouping and welcoming tone. Lacks distinctive visual treatment; follows common home-screen conventions (greeting + input + upcoming events + recent tasks).

observation.happening: Meeting notes interface with structured layout: left panel shows summary with decisions, action items, and reference markers; bottom shows transcript with speaker names and timestamps; right sidebar shows metadata and alternate view tabs.
observation.most_important: AI-driven meeting notes with hierarchical organization: executive summary → decisions/actions → searchable transcript. Reference markers link summary items to transcript locations.
observation.next_action: Review action items, click transcript timestamps to jump to relevant sections, access related files, toggle between views
anomalies: Right sidebar 'source' section (出所) seems redundant with reference markers in main content.
Horizontal layout with sidebar may cause layout issues on narrower screens.

1B26.why: Excellent information architecture for meeting notes: executive summary, categorized decisions/actions, and detailed transcript create clear hierarchy. Reference markers are thoughtful UX. Design is polished and well-organized, but the overall layout pattern (summary + transcript) is not novel in modern meeting-recording products.

observation.happening: Live meeting transcription interface showing real-time categorization of meeting content into Decided/Actions/Questions/Concerns. Features collapsible sections with timestamps and speaker names, right sidebar with transcript modes (Original/Translation/Live), bottom action suggestion panel for sharing/sending content, and AI document awareness.
observation.most_important: Real-time AI-driven meeting transcription with automatic categorization of decisions, actions, questions, concerns; integrated sharing and document tracking.
observation.next_action: Expand collapsible sections, toggle transcript modes, take suggested actions (send to client), manage permissions/notifications
anomalies: Interface is quite dense with competing information streams — recording bar, categorized sections, sidebar transcript, action suggestions, and AI document count create cognitive load.
Bottom 'AI materials' section feels disconnected from main meeting flow.

ai_look: Real-time AI categorization (Decided/Actions/Questions/Concerns) may leverage AI summaries, adding distinctive but somewhat visually noisy feature
2629.why: Well-designed for complexity, with thoughtful information organization despite density. Real-time categorization and transcript modes are distinctive features. However, the interface complexity — multiple competing panels, collapsible sections, action suggestions, and auxiliary information — sacrifices elegance and calmness. Good functional design, but not serene.

observation.happening: Settings/preferences panel for Astra app. Organized vertically by category: Shortcuts, Display Size (button-group selector with Comfortable highlighted), OS Permissions (microphone, screen capture, accessibility, speech recognition, calendar, input method) with explanatory text and status links.
observation.most_important: Permissions and preferences management with clear explanations and status indicators for each OS permission type.
observation.next_action: Change display size, click permission links to grant or confirm OS-level access
anomalies: Explanatory text for several permissions contains grammatical errors, unclear phrasing, and truncation artifacts ('...'). Examples: 'これからの会議をこと出すにはカレンダー...' is malformed.
Some text appears incomplete or AI-generated with poor Japanese grammar.

ai_look: Explanatory text shows clear signs of AI generation or poor machine translation — awkward phrasing, grammatical errors, incomplete sentences with ellipsis.
Feels like explanatory copy was auto-generated without human review.
2ED7.why: While layout and organization are competent and standard-quality for a settings panel, the explanatory text quality is noticeably poor. Grammatical errors, unclear phrasing, and AI-generated-feeling copy create friction and reduce craft quality. The **visible text defects** (malformed Japanese, truncation, unclear instructions) are observable **defects from the image itself**, not speculation. This violates basic quality standards for user-facing UI copy.
